optimized_sql:
SELECT
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_company_id,
    s.s_street_number,
    s.s_street_name,
    s.s_street_type,
    s.s_suite_number,
    s.s_city,
    s.s_county,
    s.s_state,
    s.s_zip,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 30) AS "30 days",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk > 30 AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 60) AS "31-60 days",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk > 60 AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 90) AS "61-90 days",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk > 90 AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 120) AS "91-120 days",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk > 120) AS ">120 days"
FROM date_dim d2
JOIN store_returns sr
  ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
JOIN store_sales ss
  ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
 AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
 AND ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
JOIN store s
  ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN date_dim d1
  ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
WHERE d2.d_year = 2001
  AND d2.d_moy = 8
GROUP BY
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_company_id,
    s.s_street_number,
    s.s_street_name,
    s.s_street_type,
    s.s_suite_number,
    s.s_city,
    s.s_county,
    s.s_state,
    s.s_zip
ORDER BY
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_company_id,
    s.s_street_number,
    s.s_street_name,
    s.s_street_type,
    s.s_suite_number,
    s.s_city,
    s.s_county,
    s.s_state,
    s.s_zip
LIMIT 100
